name: Nobody leaves their ancestors
text: A traveller may leave a house. No one leaves their ancestors.

inspired_by.note: Original composition after Bronze Age wisdom literature. Not a translation, and not a quotation.

notes:
Edited from the owner's draft: "A man may leave his house; he does not leave his ancestors" made ungendered.

Carried by the shaka since 2 October 2026: the owner asked for the fictional sayings to belong to the lore's various peoples, not all to the Vedda.
sources: the owner's draft of nomadic-migration sayings for the cutscenes, 2026-10-01
